title: Self-healing Playwright test agent
tagline: An AI agent that repairs broken test locators, proves the fix on the live page, and opens a pull request for a human to review.
problem: End-to-end suites break when markup changes even though the feature still works. Fixing locators by hand is slow, and an agent that patches blindly would hide real bugs.
built: A pipeline that classifies each Playwright failure, replays the passing steps in headless Chromium, shows Claude the accessibility tree, the DOM and a screenshot, asks for up to three replacement locators as validated JSON, verifies each candidate on the live page, patches only that locator with ts-morph, re-runs the test and opens a pull request. Value assertions are reported, never "healed", and nothing is merged automatically.
highlights: Classifies failures first: value assertions are reported, never patched
Each candidate must match exactly one visible element and survive the original action
Mock-provider demo heals 18 locators across 10 tests with no API key
Strict TypeScript, Vitest unit and e2e tests, GitHub Actions CI
testing: Vitest unit and end-to-end tests under strict TypeScript on GitHub Actions; the mock provider lets CI exercise the whole heal loop without an API key.
